technical_data.adversarial_training_code_snippet:
def adversarial_training(model, benign_samples, malicious_samples):
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        # Mix adversarial examples crafted to evade detection
        adversarial_examples = craft_adversarial_samples(malicious_samples)
        combined = benign_samples + adversarial_examples
        labels = [0]*len(benign_samples) + [1]*len(adversarial_examples)
        model.train(combined, labels)
    return model

example.detection_method: Implement anomaly detection on the training dataset to identify mislabeled or suspicious samples by scanning for embedded scripts or unusual payload patterns. Use data provenance and integrity verification to monitor dataset changes. Employ adversarial training by injecting crafted malicious samples during model training to increase robustness. Continuously monitor model performance metrics against a verified validation set to detect accuracy drops indicative of poisoning.
